glosses: intellectual (belonging to, or performed by, the intellect; mental or cognitive)

examples.text: Мои́ одино́кие интеллектуа́льные развлече́ния с те́нью Еле́ны отдава́ли че́м-то престу́пным и бы́ли куда́ бо́лее прия́тны мне.
examples.translation: My solitary intellectual diversions with Elena's shade had a criminal aura and were much more enjoyable.
examples.english: My solitary intellectual diversions with Elena's shade had a criminal aura and were much more enjoyable.

glosses: Pertaining to, or performed by, the intellect; mental or cognitive.

examples.text:
1920, Harold Monro, Preface to The year's at the spring; an anthology of recent poetry
Pleasure is various, but it cannot exist where the emotions or the imagination have not been powerfully stirred. Whether it be called sensual or intellectual, pleasure cannot be willed

glosses: Endowed with intellect; having a keen sense of understanding; having the capacity for higher forms of knowledge or thought; characterized by intelligence or cleverness

examples.text: The Fenimore Cooper Indian is no doubt a brave and highly intellectual person, educated abroad, refined and cultivated by foreign travel, graceful in the grub dance or scalp walk-around, yet tender-hearted as a girl, walking by night fifty-seven miles in a single evening to warn his white friends of danger.

glosses: Suitable for exercising one's intellect; perceived by the intellect

examples.text: A good deal of nonsense is written about sport and entertainment. Many of us can, with pleasant ease, suspend a severely intellectual task for a few hours to witness a first-class football match.

glosses: Relating to the understanding; treating of the mind.

examples.text: I deem not profitless those fleeting moods / Of shadowy exultation; not for this, / That they are kindred to our purer mind / And intellectual life […]

glosses: An intelligent, learned person, especially one who discourses about learned matters.

examples.text: It should be noted that there is now no intelligentsia that is not in some sense "Left". Perhaps the last right-wing intellectual was T. E. Lawrence. Since about 1930 everyone describable as an “intellectual” has lived in a state of chronic discontent with the existing order.

‘You know I hate intellectuals.’
‘You mean you hate people who are cleverer than you are.’
‘Yes. I suppose that’s why I like you so much, Tom.’

glosses: The intellect or understanding; mental powers or faculties.

examples.text: […] although their intellectuals had not failed in the theory of truth, yet did the inservient and brutall faculties control the suggestion of reason […]
„Zu den Schülern dieses intellektuellen Zentrums zählte auch Paulus.“

„Sobald wir mit dem Begriff Zeit zu experimentieren beginnen, und sei es auch nur als Gedankenexperiment oder zum rein intellektuellen Zeitvertreib, müssen wir feststellen, daß unsere Sprache und mit ihr unsere Denkprozesse uns sehr bald im Stich lassen.“

„Der Glaube, dass es einen Gott gibt, bleibt jedoch trotz der Versuche des menschlichen Geistes, sich über sogenannte Gottesbeweise, über intellektuelle Erkenntnisse und logische Schlüsse, Sicherheit zu verschaffen, ein Wagnis.“
